notes.title: POV VR Mode
notes.content:
POV mode has been added to the VR version of the Farmthis Gallery

POV in VR is tricky, locking users to position can cause motion sickness and re-centring the camera can be uncomfortable. I think there are improvements I can make so any suggestions are appreciated and I hope to improve the function based on feedback. 

To try to work around this there are 2 different ways you can centre your view. One moves your view to the position and rotation of the character head, the other moves your view to the position but ignores rotation. 

​On Vive the controls are: Recenter Type 1: Snap Rotate Left (usually left on joystick or left click on touch pad), Recenter Type 2: Snap Rotate Right (usually right on joystick or left click on touch pad)​, Start Animation (in relevant scenes): Teleport (up on joystick or top click on touchpad).
The next update will be a new scene :)
